subject: general
question: Which of the following Satyagrahas was started by Dr B R Ambedkar in 1927?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahad Satyagraha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahad Satyagraha:-**

 
 
• It is also known as the Chavdar Tale Satyagraha.
 
• **It was a non-violent resistance movement led by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar to assert the right of untouchables to use a public water tank in Mahad, Maharashtra, India. It took place on March 20, 1927.**
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, a prominent Dalit leader and intellectual, recognized the need to challenge these unjust practices. He believed in the power of education and self-improvement to uplift the Dalit community.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nasik Temple Satyagraha:-**

 
 
• It was a non-violent protest movement led by Mahatma Gandhi to allow Dalits to enter the Kalaram Temple in Nasik, Maharashtra, India.
 
• The protest took place between March 25 and April 2, 1930.
 
 
 
• **Mulshi Satyagraha:-**
 
 
• It was a non-violent protest movement led by Mahatma Gandhi to protect the rights of farmers in the Mulshi taluka of Pune district, Maharashtra, India.
 
• The protest took place between 1925 and 1927.
 
 
 
• **Dharasana Satyagraha:-**
 
 
• It was a non-violent protest movement led by Mahatma Gandhi to protest against the salt tax in India.
 
• The protest took place on May 13, 1930.
